name: Deathsight
description: Ruins silhouette through fog within 3 hexes; every combat the party wins leaves a Remnant for the rest of the expedition.

name: Speak with the Fallen
description: At a Remnant or ruin: the dead betray patrol positions and the bearing of the nearest undiscovered site.

name: Bone Scout
description: Raise a scout from a Remnant; it walks a drawn path of up to 5 hexes, charting as it goes, then collapses.

name: Pallid Bargain
description: Sacrifice 4 party HP for 3 Essence. There is deliberately no necromantic healing.
